claim: The quadratic partition-free wide-band matrix step-quench solver preserves the initially contacted equilibrium state, obeys terminal charge continuity, recovers the final stationary NEGF limit, reproduces the analytic resonant-level oracle, and returns consistent post-quench two-time Green functions within the explicit energy-cutoff error.

protocol.initial_state: device and leads contacted in common equilibrium for t < 0
protocol.quench: simultaneous h_initial -> h_final and constant lead energy shifts Delta_alpha at t = 0
protocol.approximation: noninteracting quadratic device, time-independent wide-band broadenings
protocol.numerics: caller-supplied energy cutoff and trapezoid quadrature with memory-capped energy blocks

limits: The full two-time spectral identity converges with the finite energy cutoff; the audited [-80, 80] window leaves a 1.99e-3 cutoff residual.
Post-quench Hamiltonians, lead shifts, and broadenings are constant in time.
No interacting self-energy or arbitrary smooth voltage protocol is included.
The Corbino application has not yet been switched from finite leads to this continuum solver.
